detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The demons won the war. Humanity is on the brink of extinction, and those who remain are eaten, sacrificed, or enslaved. The future is bleak. Worst of all, you still have to work for a living.

OBEY OR PERISH

Your survival ticket is the only thing between you and a demon's maw. To keep it, you'll have to complete the tasks assigned to you by your boss. The diligent are rewarded.. but there are consequences for those who disobey.

EXPLORE A BROKEN WORLD

Traverse a city overtaken by demonic influence. Talk with demons and other survivors to gather information and learn the rules that govern this new society.

CHOOSE YOUR PATH

Show that you're useful and you might live to see tomorrow -- or hold on to hope and work against the demons from within. Make a difference or die trying. 

Features:

  • Explore a shattered world and learn its rules

  • Complete tasks assigned by your superiors

  • Solve puzzles

  • Chat with demons and humans

  • Interact with detailed environments

  • Discover hidden places and secret information

  • Experience multiple endings based on your choices

  • Collect items to decorate your break room
